Envs.Name: restore
Envs.Desc: plinths fade; write a mark to restore them

Envs.Name: fire
Envs.Desc: grass ignites (mostly at hotspots) and fire spreads; clear burning cells

Envs.Name: litter
Envs.Desc: litter appears; take it and put it in a bin (dropping it elsewhere only moves it)

Envs.Name: maze
Envs.Desc: join entrance to exit with a trail of marks; the trail erodes

Envs.Name: wells
Envs.Desc: springs far apart silt up; clear them before they get bad; springs sometimes move
